subject.title: feat(apps,ui): question surface parity and composer takeover

question: Should the maintainer accept panel-as-composer as the permanent Control UI interaction model while requiring every native client to preserve question state indefinitely?
rationale: This PR deliberately establishes a cross-platform interaction and retention policy, not merely a local defect repair; the protected `maintainer` label requires explicit human ownership of that product boundary.

options.title: Sponsor the parity direction
options.body: Keep panel-as-composer and persistent summaries, then require the reusable-ID repair and native behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Land only the confirmed question-lifecycle repair work and defer the composer takeover or indefinite retention policy to a separately owned decision.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the parity direction
recommendation.body: Keep panel-as-composer and persistent summaries, then require the reusable-ID repair and native behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch history and assignment connect this contributor to the proposed cross-client behavior and its implementation boundaries.
